field_descriptions.art_edition: The number of copies when multiple copies of a piece of artwork are produced - e.g. for a limited edition of 20 prints, 'artEdition' refers to the total number of copies (in this example "20").
field_descriptions.art_medium: The material used. (E.g. Oil, Watercolour, Acrylic, Linoprint, Marble, Cyanotype, Digital, Lithograph, DryPoint, Intaglio, Pastel, Woodcut, Pencil, Mixed Media, etc.)
field_descriptions.artform: e.g. Painting, Drawing, Sculpture, Print, Photograph, Assemblage, Collage, etc.
field_descriptions.artist:
The primary artist for a work
    	in a medium other than pencils or digital line art--for example, if the
    	primary artwork is done in watercolors or digital paints.
field_descriptions.artwork_surface: The supporting materials for the artwork, e.g. Canvas, Paper, Wood, Board, etc.
field_descriptions.colorist: The individual who adds color to inked drawings.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.inker: The individual who traces over the pencil drawings in ink after pencils are complete.
field_descriptions.letterer: The individual who adds lettering, including speech balloons and sound effects, to artwork.
field_descriptions.penciler: The individual who draws the primary narrative artwork.
field_descriptions.surface: A material used as a surface in some artwork, e.g. Canvas, Paper, Wood, Board, etc.
field_descriptions.weight: The weight of the product or person.
